purpose: Teach: ニッチ/日本航空/アリーナ/ソフィア/釜山/ジャマイカ/ユニセフ/松竹

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがニッチな趣味をお持ちだった
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he had quite the niche hobby.
lines.style: Soft, reflective opening. Gentle nostalgia in the voice. Searching tone — testing memory, inviting her to remember with him. Unhurried pace.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、日本航空の機内サービスを楽しまれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh yes, Grandpa enjoyed the in-flight service on Japan Airlines, didn't he?
lines.style: Warm, playful misremembering. Slightly teasing lilt on the question tag. She's gently redirecting him with affection — indulging him while steering her own memory. Light, knowing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが武道館アリーナに通われた
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he used to go to the Budokan arena all the time.
lines.style: Same wistful quality as before but slightly more grounded. Settling into another memory. Quieter conviction. Waiting for her gentle correction again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ブルガリアのソフィアに駐在されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, he was stationed in Sofia, Bulgaria for a while, wasn't he?
lines.style: Still warm and playful but with a hint of knowing gentleness. She's caught in her own reverie now, half-matching his game. Tender smile underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが韓国釜山に出張された
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he took a business trip to Busan, Korea.
lines.style: Quieter now, more deliberate. The wistfulness has deepened slightly. He's offering these memories like small gifts. Slower tempo. Waiting.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、ジャマイカのレゲエを好まれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, he was fond of Jamaican reggae music, remember?
lines.style: She's fully in it now — her own memories rising. Lighter than before, almost dreamy. The 'remember?' is genuine, not testing — she's asking them both. Soft trailing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがユニセフに寄付された
lines.en: Gran, when Dad was young, he made donations to UNICEF.
lines.style: The tenderness has accumulated by now. Each memory offered more slowly, more carefully. Breath behind the words. He's building something — not quite a story, but a portrait.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、松竹の名作映画をご鑑賞されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Grandpa, he loved watching the classic Shochiku films, didn't he?
lines.style: Her voice has softened into pure warmth. The game has become something else — almost a duet. Close and intimate. Each word treasured. She's not correcting anymore; they're remembering together now.
